tagline: The VTuber underground, decrypted weekly — and this week the whole scene packed its bags for Los Angeles.

lead.title: The whole scene descended on Los Angeles
lead.body: Anime Expo weekend (Jul 2–5) turned into the year's biggest VTuber convergence. hololive English packed the Shrine Auditorium for its 4th concert “Serendipity,” Ironmouse and CDawgVA headlined a chaos-arcade takeover, and a parallel festival across town put indies on a full 3D stage — all in the same 72 hours. If you blinked, you missed roughly four announcements and one viral hallway clip.

stories.title: Ironmouse & CDawgVA run “Chaos Ascendant” at Anime Expo
stories.blurb: The duo's AX headline show leaned all the way into its name — a cosplay contest, an arcade takeover, and the kind of on-stage nonsense that only these two can survive. It was the loudest room at the convention, which at AX 2026 is saying something.

stories.title: hololive English's “Serendipity” fills the Shrine for two nights
stories.blurb: EN's 4th full concert ran Jul 3–4 alongside Anime Expo, including the branch's first proper duo show. Two nights, a stacked setlist, and a merch line that reportedly wrapped the block — the EN live-show era is very much here.

stories.title: Nijisanji Koshien draft kicks off the summer's pettiest sport
stories.blurb: The draft meeting streamed Jul 4 with ten director-managers named — Furen, Fuwa Minato, Himawari and friends — ahead of the main tournament Aug 8–11. It's amateur baseball as full-contact agency politics, and the group chats are already scheming.

stories.title: Phase Connect breaks cover on the “Phase ALiAS” generation
stories.blurb: The new wave, revealed late June, debuts Jul 9–10 with a secret-society theme that the teaser art is refusing to explain. Pre-debut sleuthing has been feral (see the Tea Corner). Two nights, fresh rigs, and a fanbase already picking oshis sight-unseen.

stories.title: The full-3D arms race is quietly reshaping the mid-tier
stories.blurb: Agencies like Luminara are building in-house motion-capture studios, and the 3D avatar segment is now the fastest-growing slice of the market. The upshot: a full-body 3D reveal is fast becoming a mid-year expectation, not a milestone flex.

stories.title: State of the scene: $3B market, 45 talents past a million
stories.blurb: Fresh figures peg the global VTuber market around $3.13B in 2026, with hololive counting 45 active members over a million subs and Nijisanji managing 196 livers across its branches. The scene got big; the drama, thankfully, stayed the same size.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: Dokibird headlines Fantastic Reality's “Rewind Time” matinee
indies.blurb: The mixed-reality 3D festival ran Jul 2–4 at the Vermont Hollywood, with Dokibird curating and headlining her own day-three concert. Proof that an unsigned name can now book a real venue and fill it — no agency logo required.

indies.title: “Found Futures” debuts Virtual Signal alongside kson & Lilypichu
indies.blurb: The festival's opening night paired Matara Kan, kson and Lilypichu with the live debut of a new act, Virtual Signal. A slick, fully mixed-reality showcase that felt less like an indie side-event and more like a statement.

indies.title: A shuttered agency's characters start finding new homes
indies.blurb: Word surfaced that a batch of ex-Gen designs from a long-closed agency are being handed off / sold to their talents, clearing the way for reincarnations under fresh indie banners. Somewhere, a dozen model-spotting detectives just cracked their knuckles.

tea.text: Word on /vt/ is at least one incoming Phase ALiAS member is a returning indie in a new coat of paint — the “I'd know that laugh anywhere” threads are already hundreds of posts deep. Management's only response so far has been to post the teaser again.

The rumor mill says that “characters going to new homes” from a certain closed agency means a few beloved ex-Gen models are about to resurface under fresh indie names. Reincarnation-spotting season is officially open.

Chatter insists a couple of the AX hallway hangs quietly turned into planning sessions for a surprise cross-agency 3D collab before summer's out. Allegedly the group chat is, and this is a direct quote, “feral.”

footerNote: Next signal hits Sunday. Until then — hydrate, touch grass between streams, and don't reply-guy the talents.
